name: Vitest Open-Source Test Runner
free_limit: MIT-licensed local JavaScript/TypeScript test runner with unit and component testing, snapshots and coverage integration; no vendor-metered test runs or license fee.
watch_out: Runs on your own Node.js development or CI environment; test execution, browser runners and paid CI infrastructure can incur costs. Current documentation requires compatible Node.js and Vite versions; this is not a hosted test-execution allowance.
